general: Implement the 'Unbounded' font for all headings to give a distinct Web3 look.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all data points (prices, hashes, block numbers).
The UI must be DARK MODE ONLY. Do not implement a light mode toggle.
Use the 'grid_background' pattern on the main body background to give technical depth.
Cards should have a subtle glass effect (backdrop-blur) and a thin border.
Buttons should be sharp (rounded-sm or rounded-none) to feel like a pro trading tool.
Use the provided image URLs for specific sections (Hero, Validators, AI Sentinel).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
layout_rules: Use a 'Bento Grid' layout for the Dashboard Overview.
The DEX interface must be high-density: minimize padding in tables (py-1 px-2).
The Block Explorer should look like a terminal/IDE: dark, mono font, high contrast.
Navigation should be a sidebar on desktop and a bottom bar on mobile.
animations: Add a subtle 'pulse' animation to live status indicators (green dots).
Hover states on rows should be instant (duration-75) for a snappy feel.

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic centered layouts or default Bootstrap looks.
Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very specific hero title.
Use 2-3x more spacing between SECTIONS, but tight spacing within DATA TABLES.
Never use pure black (#000000) for cards; use #0A0A0A or #121212.
Always tint greys with a hint of blue (#18181B) to avoid muddy look.
